## Run-observe-fix cycles (agent-initiated judge runs, scoring:0)

Cycles-to-pass for rung r = number of agent-initiated judge invocations
of r up to and including its FIRST in-session pass (re-verifications after
a pass are excluded). Trials that never passed r in-session are excluded
from that rung's cycle stat (reported separately as never-passed).

Cell format: median (mean, n). 'never-passed' = (trial,rung) pairs attempted
in-session but never passed, with total runs spent on them.
